title: PM Studio Group expands its packaging capabilities with TNT Group
summary: PM Studio Group, a specialist in gifting, secondary packaging, and bespoke accessories, is expanding its beauty and luxury packaging offering with the acquisition of TNT Group. The combined business generates approximately EUR 130 million (USD 145 million) in revenue and aims to become a leading global packaging partner for the beauty, luxury, and wines and spirits industries.
